t.en: This tutorial assumes that the reader already knows the basics of the Python programming language. If you do not, the official Python tutorial（https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/index.html） is excellent.
t.zh: 本教程假定读者已经掌握 Python 编程语言的基础。如果还没有，官方的 Python 教程（https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/index.html）非常好。

t.en: This tutorial assumes a decent mathematical background. Most examples require knowledge lower than a calculus level, and some require knowledge at a calculus level. Some of the advanced features require more than this. If you come across a section that uses some mathematical function you are not familiar with, you can probably skip over it, or replace it with a similar one that you are more familiar with. Or look up the function on Wikipedia and learn something new. Some important mathematical concepts that are not common knowledge will be introduced as necessary.
t.zh: 本教程假定读者有不错的数学基础。大多数示例所需的知识不超过微积分的程度，有一些则需要微积分水平的知识，个别高级功能需要的还要更多。如果你遇到某一节用到了你不熟悉的数学函数，大概可以直接跳过，或者换成一个你更熟悉的类似函数。也可以去维基百科上查一查这个函数，顺便学点新东西。一些不属于常识的重要数学概念，会在需要的时候介绍。

t.en: You will need to install SymPy first. See the installation guide.
t.zh: 你需要先安装 SymPy。请参阅安装指南。

t.en: This tutorial was the basis for a tutorial given at the 2013 SciPy conference in Austin, TX. The website for that tutorial is here（https://certik.github.io/scipy-2013-tutorial/html/index.html）. It has links to videos, materials, and IPython notebook exercises. The IPython notebook exercises in particular are recommended to anyone going through this tutorial.
t.zh: 本教程是 2013 年在美国得克萨斯州奥斯汀举办的 SciPy 大会上一场教程的基础。那场教程的网站在这里（https://certik.github.io/scipy-2013-tutorial/html/index.html），上面有视频、材料和 IPython notebook 练习的链接。尤其推荐每一位学习本教程的人做做其中的 IPython notebook 练习。
